title: 第10章 机魂不悦
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

定居点之所以能够存在，就是因为能够依靠神机进行生产，然后给奴们诺尔的贵人们纳税，以获得承认和庇护。

可现在，神机停摆了，他们定居点存在的根本也就出现了问题。

这可不是黑吃黑一波就能熬过去的事情。

最重要的是，一旦奴们诺尔方面认为是他们导致了神机停摆，那么他们定居点的罪名可就不仅仅是滞税这么简单了...

而是极为严重的“亵渎人类遗产罪”！

这是要上裁判所，甚至被多方会审的！

大门不敢再想下去了。

他没见过裁判所，也没见过处置这种大罪的场面。

但他和所有人都知道，这种事情如果落到了自己头上，一定比死还可怕。

所以，一定一定要找到修好神机的办法！

一想到被按上亵渎罪会是什么后果的大门，不由得看向了端坐在车头的寓乐。

如何维护和修理神机，自然不是他们这群三等人能知道的。

他们也就是知道如何使用和祭拜而已。

至于修理和维护，那是上面的大人们才能知道的隐秘。

所以，作为高级贵族的寓乐，应该...一定知道吧？

大门咬了咬牙，在心里反复给自己打气。

他知道自己接下来要说的话很冒险，甚至可能激怒寓乐。

但他没有别的路了。

在回去的路上，大门小心翼翼地凑到寓乐身边。

不敢靠太近，保持着一段距离，更不敢直面寓乐，只是弓着腰避免自己的口气冲到寓乐道：

“尊、尊敬的大人...我们，我们有一件事情，希望您看在我们的牺牲上，能够帮帮我们。”

说完这句话的大门连呼吸都憋住了，生怕自己听漏寓乐的任何一句话。

这是唯一的希望了！

一直紧绷着神经的寓乐瞬间提起了心神。

他很清楚的记得，那个蛮子老大说过大门他们是有求于自己的。

甚至之前他和蛮子老大对峙时说的那些话，也有一半是说给大门他们听的——

为的，就是希望明显属于第三方的大门他们能够为了自己的利益和蛮子们开干。

现在大门找来，也是寓乐能够预料的。

只是预料是预料...

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The reason why the settlement can exist is that it can rely on the divine machine to produce, and then pay taxes to the nobles of Nuol in order to gain recognition and asylum.

But now, the divine machine has stopped, and there is a problem with the very existence of their settlement.

This is not something that can be overcome by just eating black and white.

The most important thing is that once the slaves Noel believe that they caused the shutdown of the divine machine, then the crime of their settlement will not be as simple as tax arrears...

But it is an extremely serious crime of "desecration of human heritage"!

This is going to the tribunal and even being tried by multiple parties!

Damen didn't dare to think about it anymore.

He had never seen a court of justice, nor had he seen a scene where such a heinous crime was dealt with.

But he and everyone knew that if such a thing happened to him, it would be more terrifying than death.

Therefore, we must find a way to repair the magic machine!

When I thought about the consequences of being charged with blasphemy, I couldn't help but look at Yu Le who was sitting at the front of the car.

How to maintain and repair the divine machine is naturally not something that third-class people like them can know.

They just know how to use and worship it.

As for repairs and maintenance, those are secrets that only the adults above know.

Therefore, as a high-class aristocrat’s entertainment, you should...you must know it, right?

Damen gritted his teeth and encouraged himself repeatedly in his mind.

He knew what he was about to say was risky and might even anger Yule.

But he had no other choice.

On the way back, Damen cautiously approached Yu Le.

He didn't dare to get too close, so he kept a certain distance, and he didn't dare to face Yule directly. He just arched his waist to prevent his tone from rushing to Yule:

"Respected, respected sir... We, we have something to do. I hope you can help us because of our sacrifice."

After saying this, Damen held his breath, for fear that he would miss any of Yule's words.

This is the only hope!

Yule, whose nerves had been tense, suddenly lifted his mind.

He clearly remembered that the barbarian boss said that the gates and the others wanted something from him.

Even half of what he said during the confrontation with Boss Manzi was meant for Damen and the others——

The reason is that they hope that the gate that clearly belongs to a third party can fight against the barbarians for their own benefit.

Now that the door is coming, Yule can expect it.

It's just an expectation...
